title: Customers are reporting that credit card payments are failing during checkout.
description:
Customers are reporting that credit card payments are failing during checkout.
The error message shown is “Payment could not be processed at this time.”
This appears to be happening intermittently, mostly during peak hours.

Support has confirmed the issue is not limited to one card type or bank.
No recent payment system changes were made.
Issue is currently under investigation.

title: Website performance has been noticeably slow since early this morning.
description:
Website performance has been noticeably slow since early this morning.
Pages take 5–10 seconds to load, especially product search and checkout.

No outages reported, but server load is higher than usual.
Engineering suspects increased traffic combined with database query latency.
Performance tuning is ongoing.

title: Several customers report being unable to log in when
description:
Several customers report being unable to log in when 
using Safari on macOS. Chrome and Firefox appear unaffected. 
Issue started after yesterday’s frontend deployment.
